POVERGuide.source: MAPD POVER Special Batch File Process (CMS) + MAPD PCUG v19.4

Overview.Description: Guide for submitting a Plan Submitted Rollover (POVER) special batch file to CMS via MARx. Requires a two-step process: (1) request approval via MARx UI, (2) submit the POVER batch file.

Step1_ApprovalRequest.name: Special Batch File Approval Request
Step1_ApprovalRequest.Location: MARx UI > Transactions > File Submission Request (Screen M317)

Fields.Field: Must be present, unchanged, on every transaction in the POVER file.
Exact number of TC 61 transactions to be submitted for this contract/PBP; must match exactly.

Step1_ApprovalRequest.Note: Submission triggers an automated email to CMS approvers. Do NOT submit the batch file until approval is received.

Step2_HeaderRecord.name: POVER Batch File Header Record
Step2_HeaderRecord.Field: From the approved M317 UI request

CommonIssues.Issue: Submitting a POVER file without a prior approved M317 request results in automatic rejection. Error: "POVER SPECIAL FILE DETECTED, PROCESSING IS NOT APPROVED OR REQUEST ID IS NOT RECOGNIZED"
Transactions that fail validation edits after acceptance do not trigger a rejection email; they appear instead on the Batch Completion Status Summary (BCSS) report.
If the POVER file is not processed correctly, it can be edited and resubmitted (as long as it was not already processed).
